related.title: 橢圓偏光儀建置
related.transfer: 可遷移「Malus 定律、消光比與偏振元件分類」與「延遲量、軸向與消光比的量測」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；橢圓偏光儀建置的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Malus's law, extinction ratio and polarizer classes" and "Measuring retardance, axis orientation and extinction" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Ellipsometer construction must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦從 Malus 定律與雙折射出發，製作並驗證波片、晶體稜鏡、線柵與薄膜偏振元件；橢圓偏光儀建置則以從 Ψ/Δ 與菲涅耳反演到偏光元件、測角儀與擬合的橢偏儀建置為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on from Malus's law and birefringence to fabricating and verifying waveplates, crystal prisms, wire-grid and thin-film polarizers; Ellipsometer construction centres on from Ψ/Δ and Fresnel inversion to polarizing optics, goniometer and model fitting in ellipsometer construction, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「交叉偏振片與消光比」與「反射偏振比 ρ 與入射角」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到橢圓偏光儀建置，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「模型擬合、參數相關性與不確定度」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Crossed polarizers and extinction ratio” and “Reflection ratio ρ and angle of incidence”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Ellipsometer construction, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Model fitting, parameter correlation and uncertainty", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.difference: 本課聚焦從 Malus 定律與雙折射出發，製作並驗證波片、晶體稜鏡、線柵與薄膜偏振元件；液晶空間光調制器則以反射式 LCOS 相位調制器的相位行程、像素繞射、液晶響應、查找表校正與系統整合為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on from Malus's law and birefringence to fabricating and verifying waveplates, crystal prisms, wire-grid and thin-film polarizers; Liquid-crystal spatial light modulators centres on phase stroke, pixel diffraction, liquid-crystal response, lookup-table calibration and system integration of reflective LCOS phase modulators, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「交叉偏振片與消光比」與「平行配向向列液晶層」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到液晶空間光調制器，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「相位誤差預算與熱負載」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Crossed polarizers and extinction ratio” and “Parallel-aligned nematic LC layer”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Liquid-crystal spatial light modulators, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Phase-error budget and thermal load", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 偏振光學元件製作
history.text: 1808 年 Malus 發現反射光的偏振並給出以他為名的定律，1817 年 Fresnel 提出以兩次全反射產生圓偏振的菱體，1828 年 Nicol 以方解石製成第一個實用偏振稜鏡，Glan 與 Thompson 在 1880 年代改良為今天的 Glan 型稜鏡。1929 年 Edwin Land 發明聚合物片偏振片並創立 Polaroid，1946 年 MacNeille 取得薄膜偏振分光器專利；線柵偏振器從 1888 年 Hertz 的無線電實驗、1960 年 Bird 與 Parrish 的紅外線柵，到 2000 年代奈米壓印的可見光鋁線柵，把偏振元件推向大面積量產。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: Malus discovered polarization by reflection in 1808 and gave the law that bears his name; Fresnel proposed the rhomb that produces circular polarization by two total internal reflections in 1817; Nicol made the first practical calcite polarizing prism in 1828, refined by Glan and Thompson in the 1880s into today's Glan-type prisms. Edwin Land invented the polymer sheet polarizer in 1929 and founded Polaroid, and MacNeille patented the thin-film polarizing beam splitter in 1946; wire-grid polarizers run from Hertz's radio experiments of 1888 through Bird and Parrish's infrared grids of 1960 to nanoimprinted visible aluminium grids of the 2000s, bringing polarization optics to large-area mass production. This course reconstructs only public principles and engineering logic.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「Malus 定律、消光比與偏振元件分類」到「規格換算、隔離度預算與交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Malus's law, extinction ratio and polarizer classes" through "Specification conversion, isolation budget and handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
